scope: C3 2D mechanism-model development proxy only; not clean field data or physical acceptance
record_decay_note: full raw receiver tails are retained; no taper is treated as a convergence test, and archived tail levels do not certify decay
record_window: full archived receiver history; no truncation

reconstruction.purpose_of_zero_padding: interpolates time sampling to 601.2 MHz so real_bandpass can represent the 170 MHz upper carrier; does not increase bandwidth or resolution

records.coordinate_note: 2D x-invariant input; x coordinate is an H5 placeholder, not a physical cross-track/flight position
records.source_time_s_array: source physical sample axis = source_time_offset_s + n*source_dt_s
records.receiver_time_s_array: receiver physical sample axis = receiver_time_offset_s + n*receiver_dt_s
records.response_units: receiver sample units / source sample units; no extra spatial-scale normalization

official_reconstruction.representation: complex_envelope preferred; real_bandpass is twice real(carrier-modulated envelope)
official_reconstruction.periodic_boundary: complex_envelope repeats every 1/df; real_bandpass endpoint continuity is not assumed
